content: next-intl is the standard i18n library for Next.js App Router in 2026: top-level [locale] dynamic route segment, middleware (proxy.ts in Next 16) for locale detection/negotiation (cookie -> Accept-Language header -> default), per-locale JSON message files, setRequestLocale() call in every layout/page to preserve static rendering. localePrefix 'as-needed' keeps default locale unprefixed.
